Claim + final scope (skills seat, session `session_017TNzEetykdh7ceZGwuAPLq`) — **bundle anchor**; the seam-card/stale-p0 protocol card rides as member (overlapping file surface: same SKILL.md + same detector file). Maintainer rulings from the live discussion, verbatim, untranslated:

> 我建议有些暂时不准备开发的应该直接关闭。

> 用 B (seam cards: triage transfers to the fix-landing repo)

> 确认，先处理 objectstack (both execution confirmations: one-time stock reclassification, objectui migration — objectstack first)

**Finalized deliverable (one PR, supersedes this card's original ask ② — no `pm:hold-stable` label):**

1. **`pm:on-hold` 定位收窄** (SKILL.md state model): the state is legal ONLY with a machine-readable `Restart-when:` line — two forms: `closed <repo>#N` (fired by the same unlock scan as `Blocked-by:`, single body channel per the landed procedure) or an executable predicate. `manual — <reason>` is NOT a legal exit: a card no mechanism can revive is closed `not planned` with the reason and provenance in the closing comment (searchable, reopen-free, maintainer veto preserved). 「暂时不准备开发 ⇒ 直接关闭」 becomes protocol text.
2. **Detector** (`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, report-only, self-tests): `pm:on-hold` without a `Restart-when:` body line ⇒ flagged; plus the stale-p0 detector from the member card (p0 + open + unassigned + stale ⇒ flagged).
3. **Member card's seam-card half** (SKILL.md 多仓协调): file-at-destination enforced strictly per the criterion (「用 B」); console/UI defects transfer at triage; surviving true seam cards must name their reader in the body.
4. Verification-step audits from the member card (dead-letter labels × seat scopes; seam stock re-classified under the tightened criterion — listing only).

**Post-merge bookkeeping (declared, not the dev's job)**: one-time reclassification of the ~107 hold stock — objectstack's 83 first, then cloud, executed incrementally per the rate discipline by triage/seats quoting these rulings; objectui's finding-pool migration (76 cards) follows directly under the new three-way grading, skipping the hold detour.

**Serial position**: SKILL.md chain — dispatches at chain head the moment the claim-section PR merges (the merge event triggers it automatically). fable-mandatory; ADR-class human merge.

Scope addendum — Bug branch for the stock reclassification (maintainer question in the live session: 「为什么 很多 bug 也是 on-hold」; measured on objectstack's 85 holds: a large share are declared≠enforced contract-gap findings correctly typed `Bug` by the mechanical criterion, plus a handful of genuine user-reachable defects carrying `bug`/`security` labels).

**The default 「暂时不准备开发 ⇒ 关闭」 does NOT apply to `type:Bug` holds.** Their disposition branch:

- (a) reproducible, user-reachable ⇒ **back to `pm:queue`** — the selection order's Bug priority only works on queued cards; a held bug is a hidden bug;
- (b) declared≠enforced observation-class ⇒ routed to the **enforce-or-remove** program (its actual resolution path), not held and not bare-closed;
- (c) genuine won't-fix candidates ⇒ **per-card to the maintainer's decision box** — seats never close a real defect on their own authority.

The protocol text the dev writes should carry this branch in the 定位收窄 clause. Named specimens for the sweep's first pass (recorded here so they are not re-discovered): the decryptable-orphans security hold, the air-gapped-install gating hold, the test-adapter mount hold, the permission-resolution-copy hold.

# `pm:on-hold` stock reclassification — objectstack, pass 1 complete

Executed by the skills-seat bookkeeping sweep (session `session_017TNzEetykdh7ceZGwuAPLq`) under the maintainer rulings of 2026-08-16, verbatim and untranslated:

> 我建议有些暂时不准备开发的应该直接关闭。

> 确认，先处理 objectstack

Policy applied as finalized on this card (body + both scope comments): `pm:on-hold` is legal only with a machine-readable `Restart-when:` exit — `closed <owner/repo>#N` or an executable predicate; `manual — <reason>` is not a legal exit. The Bug-branch addendum was applied as written: the close-default does **not** apply to `type:Bug` / `bug` / `security` holds.

**Scope measured: 86 open `pm:on-hold` cards** (single-label query, 2026-08-16). Every one was read in full — body **and** all comments — and placed in exactly one branch. Counts reconcile: 65 + 1 + 4 + 2 + 14 = 86.

---

## Branch A — kept, machine-readable exit written to the body (65)

`Restart-when:` prepended as the body's first line. `pm:on-hold` and all `domain:*` labels preserved; no comment posted (this report is the audit).

3002, 3166, 3257, 3267, 3653, 3739, 4220, 4426, 4676, 5180, 5536, 5930, 5969, 6009, 6736, 6991, 7219, 7401, 7443, 7497, 7571, 7826, 7877, 7880, 7881, 7898, 8113, 8133, 8140, 8169, 8173, 8213, 8224, 8241, 8276, 8285, 8297, 8331, 8360, 8414, 8553, 8562, 8589, 8607, 8656, 8662, 8714, 8722, 8725, 8740, 8753, 8760, 8802, 8827, 8852, 8872, 8878, 8883, 8897, 8901, 8924, 8966, 8984, 8999, 9046

The great majority already carried a *prose* restart condition written by the triage seat — usually a named trigger file plus an incident clause. The sweep's work was converting that prose into one grep-able first line, not inventing exits. A representative spread of the forms landed:

- **`closed <repo>#N`** — 9046 (`#9054`), 8901 (`#8895` + `#8896` + `#8906`), 8331 (`#8330`), 8360 (`#7464`), 8213 (`#5082`), 8224 (`#3002`), 8169 (`#7893`), 7826 (`#7675`), 7401 (`#8757`), 3257 (`#2657`).
- **Registry / version predicates** — 3653 and 3002 (`npm view … dist-tags` reaching a stable non-rc line; note on 3002 that the rc pin *is* the fix for GHSA-p2fr-6hmx-4528 / GHSA-j8v8-g9cx-5qf4, so 1.6.x is not a retreat), 8562 (next `@objectstack/spec` major window).
- **Executable greps** — 8999 (`SYSTEM_FIELDS|IMPLICIT_FIELDS` outside the known #8996 set), 8802 (`valid_from|valid_until` on `sys-member.object.ts`), 7443 (a third `AUTHORING_SURFACES` value), 5969 (`components/schemas` under `packages/rest/src` going non-zero), 5930 (`target:v17` bug set reaching zero — the approved convergence investigation then starts automatically), 8140 (`domain:cli` queue reaching empty).
- **Trigger files** — 8897, 8872, 8827, 8753, 8740, 8725, 8722, 8662, 8607, 8589, 8553, 8297, 8276, 8241, 8173, 8133, 8113, 7898, 7881, 7877, 6009, 3739 and others.
- **A dated retirement clock** — 5536 (`ResolvedSettingValue.source`: if no consumer by 2027-08-07, the one-year clock set by the 2026-08-07 sweep, retire the field under ADR-0049).

⚠️ Three A-cards deserve the seats' eyes because their exit is now explicit and *overdue* rather than distant: **4676** (v17 GA already satisfied; the only remaining conjunct is a delta-report prerequisite card that may never have been filed — filing it is the next step), **4426** (blocked solely on a HotCRM zh-CN corpus sample somebody has to ask the requester for), **6991** (a maintainer already ruled on 2026-08-10 that `Console Pin Freshness` be added to the required set; it closes the moment the settings action happens).

## Branch B — Bug branch

### (a) requeued `pm:on-hold` → `pm:queue` (1)

**7983** — `HttpTestAdapter`'s record action types resolve the default API mount only; any deployment setting `api.apiPath` or `crud.dataPrefix` gets 404s. Native type `Bug`, reproducible from a measured config table, user-reachable. Labels now `bug, domain:cli, pm:queue` (verified by read-back); one-line comment posted citing the Bug-branch ruling and this seat's session.

### (b) enforce-or-remove routing (0)

No card in this stock is a `Bug`-typed declared≠enforced contract-gap observation. Three **Task**-typed cards in Branch A are nonetheless ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove shaped and are flagged here so the programme can pull them without re-discovery: **9046** (the ADR-0091 D5 `last_certified_at` / `certified_by` pair — no producer, no consumer, on a compliance surface), **8213** (`VISIBILITY_STRICT_OPTIONS` published without its type), **8562** (the ADR-0104 dead value-schema exports, already decided, major-gated).

### (c) decision box — no action taken, listed for the maintainer (4)

⛔ None of these was touched: `security`-labelled and `bug`-labelled holds are list-only under the hard rules.

| card | one-line reason |
|---|---|
| **8103** | `bug` + `security`. Pre-#8030 rotations left decryptable `sys_secret` orphans; the maintainer already ruled the vehicle (opt-in operator command, dry-run default, ⛔ no boot migration) and the report half landed. The destructive half is gated on decision card **#8259**, and the dev's re-measurement **falsified reachability fact 2** — `sys_setting.value_enc` is *not* the sole handle holder, so a settings-keyed sweep would delete live datasource and business-row secrets. Needs the ruling on #8259, not a sweep verdict. |
| **8672** | `security` + native type `Bug`. Package permission sets materialize under a tenant-less system context, so `sys_permission_set` rows land organization-less and every tenant reads them. Harm unmeasured; may be correct by design (the per-tenant decision is arguably the *binding*, not the set). A contract question with no victim — maintainer's call. |
| **1883** | `security` + `protocol:breaking`. The M2 `allowRestore` / `allowPurge` placeholder. Maintainer ruled 2026-08-03 「不现在做」; the evaluator is fail-closed and the ops do not exist, so gating them would be false compliance. Note the tripwire added by #7809: `engine-middleware-operation-vocabulary.test.ts` goes red the moment a destructive verb joins the union, and the two raw `opCtx.operation` sites in `security-plugin.ts` must be normalised **in the same batch**. |
| **7616** | `bug`-labelled but observation-class by its own framing: the `/auth/me/permissions` + `/me/apps` permission-resolution copy. Its two user-facing drift instances (#7608, #7555) are separately fixed, and step 1 landed as PR #7829; step 2 is genuinely unreachable until a floor version carrying `resolvePermissionSetsForContext` can be assumed. Suggest the `domain:cli` seat either re-type it `Task` with a version-floor `Restart-when:`, or requeue step 2 — this sweep would not close a `bug`-labelled card either way. |

## Branch C — closed `not planned` (2)

Both carry the two verbatim rulings, provenance, the card's specific held-reason, and the reopen sentence. `domain:*` labels preserved; verified by read-back (`state_reason: not_planned`).

**8381** — the maintainer ruled 2026-08-15 to keep option A (the shipped exactness-bounded `nameField` strip); option C was measurably disproved on the thread and option B stays ruled out. The residual is a persistence-fidelity gap with zero measured pull whose only exit was a human report of a lost declaration. The PM seat's own recommendation on the thread read "keep A, and **close or hold** this card".

**5958** — the `default-project` slot card. Its load-bearing claim is measured **false**: the `domain:cli` seat read `cloud` on 2026-08-12 and found `createSingleEnvironmentPlugin` is a recorded *rename*, not a phantom — which unseats the 2026-08-09 maintainer route-2 ruling and makes **both** proposed directions unsafe. The recorded exit was "on hold until the card is rewritten around what the two repos actually register", i.e. an editorial act no mechanism can fire.

## Branch D — skipped and listed (14)

⛔ No labels, bodies or states touched.

**Train-parked — `target:v17` / `target:v18` (10).** The release board is their named reader; a `Restart-when:` line would duplicate the train.
2657, 5058, 5082, 6275, 6590, 7611, 8345, 8346, 8347, 8641

**Assigned / in-flight (3).**
- **8343** — assignee `os-zhuang`; `bug`. Its fix PR #8358 merged; the card is deliberately held open (`Part of`, not `Fixes`) until an EE image carries it, because the reporter measured a published image. Not a lack of appetite — awaiting a release.
- **8006** — assignee `huangyiirene`. Maintainer ruled 2026-08-12 「do not tighten」 (the explicit carve-out to the publish-refusal principle). Assigned, so out of this sweep's reach.
- **8163** — moved out from under the sweep: the spec seat graded it `pm:queue` and claimed it at 08:29Z (branch `claude/issue-8163-currency-guidance-prescription`) while this pass was running. No longer `pm:on-hold`.

**Ambiguous — deliberately over-listed (1).**
- **8501** — the licensed `max_nodes` slot-claim mechanism. Its restart ("first real licensed multi-node deployment where the cap must bind") is demand-shaped and would ordinarily close under this policy, **but** the card is the sole record of an unenforced maintainer ruling (`objectstack-ai/cloud#1275`: refuse the excess replicas, run to the paid limit, warn loudly) and the maintainer personally parked it two days ago, 2026-08-14. Closing it would drop the only trace that a ruled behaviour is unenforced in shipped code. Per "when in doubt between C and D, choose D" this is listed rather than closed — **the maintainer's call**: close it under the new ruling, or leave it parked as the ruling's outstanding-work marker.

## Telemetry

| checkpoint | core | graphql |
|---|---|---|
| start | 15000 | 5000 |
| ~30 cards | 14993 | 5000 |
| ~45 cards | 14985 | 5000 |
| ~55 cards | 14977 | 5000 |
| end | 14976 | 5000 |

Well inside the stop thresholds (graphql ≥ 1000, core ≥ 3000) throughout. **No cards left unprocessed** — all 86 are dispositioned.

## Notes for the next pass

1. **Body edits were made through the REST API rather than the MCP write path**, deliberately: `issue_read` returns HTML-entity-escaped bodies (`'`, `"`, `>`), and re-emitting ~65 multi-KB bodies by hand is precisely how entity damage gets introduced. REST returns and accepts raw markdown, so the prepend never re-transcribes the body at all. The first edit (#9046) and the first close (#8381) were both read back and verified: entities intact as literal characters, `domain:*` labels preserved, `state_reason: not_planned` correct.
2. ⚠️ **A server-side hook appends an extra `_Generated by [Claude Code]_` footer on each body edit**, so edited cards now carry the footer twice. Cosmetic, no content loss — flagging it so it is not later read as sanitizer damage.
3. **cloud (15 holds) and objectui (9 holds, plus the un-migrated 76-card `finding` pool) are untouched**, per 「先处理 objectstack」. objectui's migration was declared on this card to follow directly under the new three-way grading, skipping the hold detour.
4. The single most common shape found: a hold whose restart condition was **real, specific and well-reasoned — but written as prose in a comment, with no seat to read it**. Several threads say so outright (#8827, #8802 and #8140 each record a vacant seat as the trigger's only reader; #5536's opportunistic condition was retired by the maintainer after four measured misses). The `Restart-when:` body line plus the #9043 detector is the right fix for exactly this, and this sweep is its first stock-wide application.
